name: Citrus Burst Launch
description: Two chilled 330ml cans tumble through the air in a dynamic diagonal against a vivid saturated color field with a bright radial glow behind them, real citrus slices and water crowns flying alongside, condensation beaded across every surface. Bright, appetizing, high-energy launch-day advertising.
lighting: Bright radial backglow, crisp flash-frozen highlights
subject: product
prompt: two traditional 330ml aluminium cans with a matte deep-teal body and a bare brushed-aluminium top rim, tumbling through the air in a dynamic diagonal arrangement, one higher and rotated toward camera, against a vivid saturated lime-green color field with a bright radial glow blooming directly behind them and falling off to deeper green at the corners, real lime slices and wedges flying alongside the cans with their translucent segments backlit, arcs of clear water wrapping the cans in torn asymmetric sheets that break into unevenly sized droplets, heavy fresh condensation beaded across the aluminium with larger drops running into tracks, crisp flash-frozen highlights along every can edge, the cans large and dominant in frame and tack-sharp while the flying fruit softens slightly with distance, bright clean appetizing high-energy commercial beverage advertising, no rendered text or logos anywhere, the frame filled edge to edge with the color field cropped by all four corners
